rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a) and Article 111 of the Constitution the President submitted Dmitry Medvedev's candidacy for the State Duma's consent to his appointment as Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation.
